description: Sequential IXP ISL failovers on AS102-AS105 every 27s. Each satellite AS has ONE link to the IXP relay (AS110). When it fails, SCION must reroute via the backbone. No backup IXP link exists.

events.description: AS102 IXP ISL down; SCION reroutes via backbone (101 or 104)
AS103 IXP ISL down; SCION reroutes via backbone (101 or 105)
AS104 IXP ISL down; SCION reroutes via backbone (102 or 106)
AS105 IXP ISL down; SCION reroutes via backbone (103 or 106)
